_howToUse: Each section below is one category on the site. To show a real product, add it to that category's items list: { "name": "...", "image": "/images/file.webp", "alt": "...", "price": "optional text" }. Items appear automatically. Leave price out to show 'Ask on WhatsApp'. Drop photos in public/images/.

wear.name: Frocks & everyday dresses
wear.blurb: Easy dresses for school-free days, family visits and the trip to the bakery. Tell us the age and we'll show you what fits.

wear.name: Party & festive wear
wear.blurb: Something special for Eid, Onam, Vishu, Christmas, birthdays and weddings in the family. Ask early when a function is coming up.

wear.name: Western wear
wear.blurb: Smart-casual looks and playful everyday sets, chosen to be stylish and comfortable for little ones.

wear.name: Baby sets
wear.blurb: Sets for the smallest customers, and a good place to start if you're choosing a gift for a new baby.

wear.name: Kids' accessories
wear.blurb: The small things that finish an outfit. Bring the dress along, or send us a photo, and we'll help you match it.

toys.name: Educational toys
toys.blurb: Toys for building, sorting, counting and figuring things out. Tell us the child's age and what they enjoy, and we'll narrow it down.

toys.name: Soft toys
toys.blurb: Something to hug, name and carry everywhere, and usually the first thing small hands reach for on the shelf.

toys.name: Imported toys
toys.blurb: A changing shelf of imported toys. The range moves with each new arrival, so ask what's available this week.

toys.name: Gifts
toys.blurb: Birthday tomorrow and no idea what to buy? Tell us the age and your budget, and we'll suggest a few things.
